info.name: Tapi Social Media API
info.description:
Complete collection for the Tapi backend. Select the **Tapi Local** environment (baseUrl = http://localhost:8080). Tokens are saved automatically after login / OTP verification / refresh. Run the folders top-to-bottom (Collection Runner) – later requests reuse ids saved by earlier ones.

File uploads use `fixtures/sample.png`: set Postman's working directory to the `postman/` folder (Settings → General → Working directory) or re-select the file.

OTP: after *Login with email*, copy the e-mailed code into the `otpCode` environment variable (in development with EMAIL_TRANSPORT=file look in `.mail-outbox/`).

item.name: AUTH
item.description: Registration, login (username / e-mail + OTP), refresh-token rotation, logout, password change.

request.description: Creates an account. A taken **username** returns 409 USERNAME_TAKEN (usernames are public). A taken **e-mail** is NOT revealed: the response looks exactly like a success (anti-enumeration).

item.name: Register user C (non-member, for error cases)
Register user D (disposable: logout-all, password change, account deletion)

request.description: Username + password. Returns tokens directly. Access token = 15 min, refresh token = 7 days.

exec: const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.environment.set("accessTokenB", d.accessToken); pm.environment.set("refreshTokenB", d.refreshToken);

request.description: E-mail + password. A 6-digit one-time code is e-mailed (valid 10 min, single use). The code is NEVER in the response or logs. With EMAIL_TRANSPORT=file in development it is written to `.mail-outbox/`.
Paste the e-mailed code into the environment variable `otpCode` first. (Optional automation: set `otpHelperUrl` to a local helper that returns the latest code.)

exec: const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.environment.set("accessToken", d.accessToken); pm.environment.set("refreshToken", d.refreshToken); pm.environment.unset("otpCode");

request.description: Every refresh issues a NEW refresh token and supersedes the old one. Re-sending a superseded token revokes the whole sign-in chain (401 REFRESH_TOKEN_REUSED).
Ends only the sign-in chain of the supplied refresh token (this device). The pre-request script logs in a throw-away session so your main session stays usable.

exec: const post = (path, body) => new Promise((res) => pm.sendRequest({ url: base + path, method: "POST", header: { "Content-Type": "application/json" }, body: { mode: "raw", raw: JSON.stringify(body) } }, (e, r) => { try { res(e ? null : r.json()); } catch (x) { res(null); } }));
const val = (j, k) => (j && j.data ? j.data[k] : undefined);
const idOf = (r) => { try { return r.json().data.id; } catch (x) { return undefined; } };
const loginD = () => post("/auth/login", { identifier: pm.environment.get("usernameD"), password: pm.environment.get("passwordD") });

request.description: Editors may leave. The admin may not (409 ADMIN_CANNOT_LEAVE).
Idempotent: 201 the first time, 200 afterwards; never a duplicate.
Idempotent too: unsubscribing from a page you are not subscribed to returns 200 with removed=false.

request.description: multipart/form-data. Only page members (admin/editors) can publish.

exec: const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.environment.set("postId", d.id); pm.test("author + ISO timestamps", () => { pm.expect(d.author.username).to.eql(pm.environment.get("username")); pm.expect(d.createdAt).to.match(/Z$/); });

request.description: Up to 10 images, max 5 MB each, JPEG/PNG/GIF/WebP/BMP (validated by file signature).

exec: const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.environment.set("postWithImageId", d.id); pm.test("image url returned", () => pm.expect(d.images[0]).to.match(/^\/uploads\/posts\//));
const p = pm.response.json().data.pageInfo; pm.test("page info", () => pm.expect(p).to.have.keys("size", "position", "hasNextPage", "nextPosition"));

request.description: {{replyId}} was written by user B; user A (even as page admin) may not edit it – editing is author-only.
Types: like, love, haha, wow, sad, angry. One reaction per user per post; sending another type REPLACES the previous one.

exec: const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.test("replaced, not added", () => { pm.expect(d.counts.love).to.eql(1); pm.expect(d.counts.like).to.eql(0); pm.expect(d.counts.total).to.eql(1); });

const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.test("counts + myReaction + items", () => { pm.expect(d.counts).to.have.property("total"); pm.expect(d).to.have.property("myReaction"); pm.expect(d.items).to.be.an("array"); });

request.description: Field name `image`. Real file signature is checked (JPEG/PNG/GIF/WebP/BMP), max 5 MB. The previous picture is deleted.

exec: const url = pm.response.json().data.picture; pm.environment.set("profilePictureUrl", url); pm.test("served from /uploads", () => pm.expect(url).to.match(/^\/uploads\/profiles\//));

pm.test("last page of 60 posts", () => { const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d.items.length).to.eql(20); pm.expect(d.pageInfo.hasNextPage).to.eql(false); });
